Cross-check the full first-game catalog, not only our questions.

New cards for existing characters are eligible after individual checks against StS1; no entirely new mechanic is required. Other cards and relics use Stars, Forge/Sovereign Blade, Osty/Summon, Doom or co-op.
Soul-only effects, Eternal, renamed effects, returning enemy families and numeric retunes do not qualify.
